database_scope.note: Connected project and branch labels verified; not an audit of all billing channels or all identity accounts. Only SELECT queries were executed.

queries.name: account_billing_and_legacy_inventory
queries.sql:
SELECT now() AS queried_at_utc, current_database() AS database_name,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles) AS profile_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '30 days') AS profiles_created_last_30d,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.subscriptions) AS subscription_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.subscriptions WHERE plan_tier NOT IN ('free','byok','local-only')) AS nonfree_subscription_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.subscriptions WHERE plan_tier NOT IN ('free','byok','local-only') AND status='active') AS active_nonfree_subscription_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.subscriptions WHERE plan_tier NOT IN ('free','byok','local-only') AND status='trialing') AS trialing_nonfree_subscription_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id IS NOT NULL OR apple_original_transaction_id IS NOT NULL OR google_purchase_token IS NOT NULL) AS subscription_rows_with_payment_identifiers,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.processed_stripe_events) AS processed_stripe_event_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.organization_billing_invoices WHERE amount_paid_cents > 0) AS positive_paid_org_invoice_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.enterprise_offline_payment_records WHERE amount_cents > 0) AS positive_offline_payment_record_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.beta_redemptions) AS beta_redemption_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.waitlist) AS paid_waitlist_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.cloud_managed_waitlist) AS cloud_managed_waitlist_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.cloud_waitlist) AS cloud_waitlist_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_analytics_events) AS analytics_event_rows,
(SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM public.product_analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= now()-interval '30 days') AS analytics_users_last_30d,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_metric_days) AS product_metric_day_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.conversations) AS conversation_rows,
(SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM public.conversations) AS conversation_account_count,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE role='user') AS user_message_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.messages WHERE role='assistant') AS assistant_message_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.managed_usage_requests) AS managed_usage_request_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.managed_usage_requests WHERE provider_succeeded_at IS NOT NULL) AS requests_with_provider_success,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.managed_usage_requests WHERE client_delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS requests_with_client_delivery,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.provider_cost_events) AS provider_cost_event_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.cogs_adjustments) AS cogs_adjustment_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.feedback) AS feedback_rows
queries.interpretation: The conversations/messages counts refer to legacy tables and must not be used for current Web usage. See current_web_persistence instead. Active nonfree subscription is not cash revenue.

queries.name: billing_usage_provenance
queries.sql:
SELECT 'subscription_mix' AS dataset, jsonb_agg(x) AS result FROM (SELECT plan_tier,status,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE stripe_subscription_id IS NOT NULL) AS stripe_subscription_links,count(*) FILTER (WHERE stripe_coupon_id IS NOT NULL) AS coupon_links,min(created_at) AS first_created,max(updated_at) AS last_updated FROM public.subscriptions GROUP BY plan_tier,status) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_account_classification',jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT s.plan_tier,s.status,s.current_period_end,s.cancel_at_period_end,s.stripe_coupon_id IS NOT NULL AS coupon_present,p.email ILIKE '%@agiworkforce.com' AS product_domain_email,p.display_name ILIKE $1 OR split_part(p.email,'@',1) ILIKE $1 OR split_part(p.email,'@',1) ILIKE $2 AS founder_name_hint FROM public.subscriptions s LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=s.user_id WHERE s.plan_tier NOT IN ('free','byok','local-only')) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'usage_rollup',jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT status,attempt_outcome,count(*) AS requests,count(distinct user_id) AS accounts,min(created_at) AS first_seen,max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM public.managed_usage_requests GROUP BY status,attempt_outcome) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'provider_cost_rollup',jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT capability,reconciliation_status,count(*) AS events,count(distinct user_id) AS accounts,sum(provider_cost_cents) AS legacy_provider_cost_cents,sum(billed_cents) AS legacy_billed_cents,sum(provider_estimated_cost_microusd) AS provider_estimated_microusd,sum(provider_reported_cost_microusd) AS provider_reported_microusd,min(occurred_at) AS first_seen,max(occurred_at) AS last_seen FROM public.provider_cost_events GROUP BY capability,reconciliation_status) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'analytics_consent_latest',jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT purpose,granted,count(*) AS accounts FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id,purpose) user_id,purpose,granted FROM public.consent_records WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id,purpose,recorded_at DESC) c WHERE purpose='product_analytics' GROUP BY purpose,granted) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'feedback_counts',jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS feedback_rows,count(distinct user_id) AS accounts,min(created_at) AS first_seen,max(created_at) AS last_seen FROM public.feedback) x
queries.interpretation: Founder-name match is a heuristic only. All cost-event rows reported estimated, with no provider-reported cost; neither legacy billed cents nor customer ledger charges prove collected revenue.

queries.name: test_markers
queries.sql:
SELECT 'profiles' AS dataset,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE id ~* '^(test|demo|seed|fixture|probe|smoke|audit|verify|validation)' OR email ~* '(example\.(com|org|net)|test\.local|invalid)$') AS test_marker_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE display_name ILIKE $1 OR split_part(email,'@',1) ILIKE $1 OR split_part(email,'@',1) ILIKE $2) AS founder_name_hint_rows FROM public.profiles
UNION ALL SELECT 'provider_cost_events',count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE source_ref ~* '(test|seed|fixture|probe|live.proof|smoke|synthetic|validation|proof|verify|audit)'),NULL FROM public.provider_cost_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'managed_usage_requests',count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE idempotency_key ~* '(test|seed|fixture|probe|live.proof|smoke|synthetic|validation|proof|verify|audit)'),NULL FROM public.managed_usage_requests
queries.interpretation: String markers flag possible verification/seed traffic, not a complete or reliable internal-account exclusion list.

queries.name: current_web_persistence
queries.sql:
SELECT now() AS queried_at_utc,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_conversations) AS current_conversation_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_conversations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS undeleted_conversation_rows,
(SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM public.web_conversations) AS conversation_accounts,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_conversations WHERE activated_at IS NOT NULL) AS activated_conversation_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_messages) AS current_message_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_messages WHERE role='user') AS user_message_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.web_messages WHERE role='assistant') AS assistant_message_rows,
(SELECT count(distinct c.user_id) FROM public.web_messages m JOIN public.web_conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE m.role='user' AND m.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days') AS accounts_with_user_message_last_30d,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_projects WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS undeleted_projects,
(SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM public.user_projects WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS project_accounts,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.project_knowledge_files WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS undeleted_project_knowledge_files,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.research_reports) AS research_report_rows,
(SELECT count(*) FROM public.research_reports WHERE status='completed') AS completed_research_reports,
(SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM public.research_reports) AS research_report_accounts
queries.interpretation: Counts of stored activity are not qualified external users, task acceptance, or cohort retention.

queries.name: observed_repeat_chat_days
queries.sql:
WITH daily AS (SELECT c.user_id,(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date AS activity_day,count(*) AS user_messages FROM public.web_messages m JOIN public.web_conversations c ON c.id=m.conversation_id WHERE m.role='user' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.created_at>=now()-interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1,2),
account_days AS (SELECT user_id,count(*) AS active_days,sum(user_messages) AS user_messages FROM daily GROUP BY user_id),
classified AS (SELECT d.*,coalesce(p.display_name ILIKE $1 OR split_part(p.email,'@',1) ILIKE $1 OR split_part(p.email,'@',1) ILIKE $2,false) AS founder_name_hint FROM account_days d LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=d.user_id)
SELECT count(*) AS accounts_with_undeleted_user_messages_last_30d,count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_days>=2) AS accounts_on_two_or_more_days,count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_days>=4) AS accounts_on_four_or_more_days,count(*) FILTER (WHERE founder_name_hint) AS accounts_with_founder_name_hint,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT founder_name_hint) AS accounts_without_founder_name_hint,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT founder_name_hint AND active_days>=2) AS accounts_without_hint_on_two_or_more_days,sum(user_messages) AS undeleted_user_messages_last_30d FROM classified
queries.interpretation: Rolling 30-day window; currently undeleted stored user messages and conversations only; activity days use America/Chicago. Founder-name hints are unverified. No-hint accounts are not thereby verified external customers. Deleted/temporary/other-surface activity and migration history can be missed.

stripe_method.matching: Database subscription identifiers were MD5-fingerprinted privately and compared with returned IDs. No fingerprints or IDs retained in this artifact.
stripe_method.result: The sole active nonfree database subscription matched a Stripe resource with livemode=false. Six canceled legacy fingerprints were not found in this selected test account's default list; this does not establish live-mode status for them.
limitations: Default list excludes subscriptions associated with test clocks unless a customer or test_clock filter is set.
The database paid row has an older current_period_end than the matched Stripe resource. No billing record was changed.
